k:把.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) curl in a swirl (巴) around the handle, closing as tight as a snail shell so that it cannot slip away. Grasp (faggot, bunch).
k:把.hint: Fingers curled like a snail shell.

k:磁.mnemonic: A stone (石) that pulls tiny (幺) iron filings towards itself, so that they hang from it in two tiny (幺) dangling chains. Magnet (porcelain).

k:潤.mnemonic: The king (王) stands in his gate (門) as the tsunami (氵) washes through. He comes out soaked to the crown, but his gardens have been watered for free. Wet (be watered, profit by, receive benefits).

k:魅.mnemonic: Six (六) pale lights drift round a tree (木) at night, and your soul (魂) feels drawn out of you towards them. You cannot look away. Fascination (charm, bewitch).
k:魅.hint: Six lights circling a tree at night.

k:乞.mnemonic: A figure bent low over a curved back, with one arm stretched out at the top holding a hand open for a coin. Beg (invite, ask, question).
k:乞.hint: Bent figure with an open hand.

k:暇.mnemonic: The work is finished and there is still day (日) left over, and also (又) nothing at all that you need to do with it. Spare time (rest, leisure, time).
k:暇.hint: Daylight left and nothing to do.

k:拐.mnemonic: A stranger tries to seduce (召) the prize poodle closer with a biscuit. Then quick fingers (扌) whisk it into a sack and he is gone. Kidnap (falsify).
k:拐.hint: Prize poodle whisked into a sack.

k:鍵.mnemonic: A small gold (金) thing shaped like a brush (聿). The jailer takes a long stride (廴) down the corridor, pushes it into the lock, and turns. Key.
k:鍵.hint: Jailer strides up and turns it.

k:陛.mnemonic: Steps cut into a mound (阝) of soil (土) lead up to the throne. Nobody standing below can compare (比) with the one seated at the top. Highness (steps of the throne).
k:陛.hint: Steps up to the one above all.

k:胆.mnemonic: One (一) small bright (明) green pouch tucked under the liver. The old doctors said that a person's bravery was stored inside it. Gall bladder (courage, pluck, nerve).

k:憂.mnemonic: His forehead (冖) droops, his self (自) is counting a hundred (百) worries, his heart (心) has sunk to his boots, and the boots just trudge (夂) on through the rain. Melancholy (grieve, lament, be anxious).

k:盾.mnemonic: An overhang (厂) of wood held in front of you, with a slit for the eye (目). Ten (十) blows of an axe (斤) land on it and you are untouched. Shield (escutcheon, pretext).
k:盾.hint: Peeping through a slit, blows bouncing off.

k:隙.mnemonic: A crack in the mound (阝): the day (日) shines through it as a thin line, with a small (小) sliver of rock above and a small (小) sliver below. Crevice (fissure, discord, opportunity).
k:隙.hint: Daylight through a crack in the mound.

k:培.mnemonic: The gardener makes every seedling stand (立) up straight, and when the hose runs dry he will spit (吐) a mouthful of water onto each root rather than let one wilt. Cultivate (foster).
k:培.hint: Gardener watering roots by the mouthful.

k:洪.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) and every river rising together (共): the waters join into a single sheet that covers the whole plain. Deluge (flood, vast).
k:洪.hint: All waters joining into one sheet.

k:墨.mnemonic: Black (黒) soot pressed into a hard stick like a cake of dried soil (土). Rub it with water on a stone and you can write. Black ink (India ink, ink stick, Mexico).

k:恭.mnemonic: At the village well (井) he bows before drawing water, hat in his hand and heart (心) held low and humble, because the water is a gift. Reverent (respect).

k:悼.mnemonic: An eminent (卓) teacher has died. In the silent hall you hear only your own heartbeat (忄), slow and heavy with the loss. Lament (grieve over).

k:糖.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) of the sweet stall, rice (米) is boiled down to syrup and spun into candy that melts the moment it touches your mouth (口). Sugar.

k:脂.mnemonic: A spoon (匕) lifted out of the stew comes up bright (明) and shiny, coated in a slick that will not rinse off under cold water. Grease (fat, tallow, lard).

k:賭.mnemonic: Someone (者) pushes his whole pile of shellfish (貝) money onto the table and shuts his eyes while the dice roll. Gamble (wager, bet).
k:賭.hint: All the shell money on one roll.

k:絹.mnemonic: Thread (糸) spun from the mouth (口) of a caterpillar: it works for a month (月) and wraps itself in the finest, smoothest cloth there is. Silk.

k:敢.mnemonic: He tiptoes up to the sleeping giant and strikes (攵) it on the ear (耳) with a twig, just to see what happens. Daring (brave, bold, sad).

k:呈.mnemonic: A mouth (口) calls out above the king (王), announcing each gift as it is held up before the throne for the whole court to see. Display (offer, present, send).
k:呈.hint: Gifts announced and held up high.

k:跳.mnemonic: A black cat crosses your path, a bad portent (兆). You lift one leg (足) and bounce three times on the other to cancel the bad luck. Hop (leap up, spring, jerk).
k:跳.hint: Three bounces to cancel a black cat.

k:骸.mnemonic: What a person (人) leaves behind in the end: take one dry white piece from the skeleton (骨) and hold it up to the light. Bone (body, corpse, physique).
k:骸.hint: One dry white piece held up.

k:鼓.mnemonic: On the left a round skin stretched on a stand with tassels on top. On the right a hand holding a stick, raised and ready to beat it. Drum (beat, rouse, muster).
k:鼓.hint: Stretched skin and a raised stick.

k:忙.mnemonic: On the left a racing heart with a tick on each side. On the right a figure dashing round a corner, already gone before you can speak. Busy (occupied, restless).

k:憤.mnemonic: Someone has trampled the flowers (艹) and taken ten (十) shellfish (貝) from the shrine. Your heartbeat (忄) pounds in your ears with indignation. Aroused (resent, be indignant, anger).

k:縛.mnemonic: Dr. (博) Stitch winds surgical thread (糸) round and round the roast chicken until it cannot move a wing. Truss (arrest, bind, tie).
k:縛.hint: The doctor ties up the roast.
